subject: [RFC PATCH 25/57] mm/collapse: collapse anonymous memory with the new engine

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new engine to collapse anonymous memory in the Linux kernel. The old mechanism is replaced, and the new one allows collapsing of anonymous memory under mmap_read lock instead of holding mmap_write for its duration. This change improves performance by allowing faults elsewhere in the address space to continue while the collapse operation runs. Additionally, even if a table cannot be collapsed into a single huge page, the engine still identifies the largest windows within it. The patch updates several files including mm/collapse.c and mm/khugepaged.c.
